title: quickspecSL
description: This program makes a *.spec file after a set of intermediate surfaces have been generated with SurfLayers. It can also make a *.spec file that relates inflated surfaces to anatomically-correct surfaces.

surf_intermed_pref.description: Prefix for (anatomically-correct) intermediate surfaces, typically output by SurfLayers (default: isurf)
surf_intermed_pref.title: Intermediate Surface Prefix

infl_surf_intermed_pref.description: Prefix for (inflated) intermediate surfaces, typically output by SurfLayers (default: infl.isurf)
infl_surf_intermed_pref.title: Inflated Intermediate Surface Prefix

both_lr_flag.description: Specify an output spec for both hemispheres if surfaces for both exist
both_lr_flag.title: Both Hemispheres Flag
